description: This file implements the Replay Protection List (RPL) management for Bluetooth Mesh in Zephyr OS, including functions for updating, checking, clearing, resetting, and storing RPL entries, as well as handling persistent storage and configuration.

methods.name: bt_mesh_rpl_update
methods.description: Updates the RPL entry with new sequence number, source address, and IV index status based on received network message.

methods.name: bt_mesh_rpl_check
methods.description: Checks the RPL for replay attempts; returns true if a replay is detected or RPL is full, and optionally provides the matching RPL entry.

methods.name: bt_mesh_rpl_clear
methods.description: Clears the entire RPL list, either immediately or by scheduling persistent storage update.

methods.name: bt_mesh_rpl_reset
methods.description: Resets the RPL list, marking entries as old or removing them, depending on configuration.

methods.name: bt_mesh_rpl_pending_store
methods.description: Stores pending RPL entries to persistent storage, optionally clearing or resetting entries based on address.
